scope: Olympia Terminal / Laivasillankatu opening and Etelaranta platforms; not the entire harbour route
axes: Local metres; X east, Y up, Z south; origin 24.9522 E, 60.1701 N
geometrySource: Bundled City of Helsinki municipal city.pack, CC BY 4.0; footprint IDs preserved in src/harbour-layout.js

references.view: Laivasillankatu, about 50 m farther north; reference is not a live camera
Laivasillankatu apron, rock and trailer storage
Eteläranta northbound suspended turn signs; one left and two right arrows

platforms.accuracy: Municipal footprints; height, railing profile, stops' signs and benches approximated

redCycleways.accuracy: Mapped dedicated cycleway polygons; colour interpreted from photos, not all cycleways assumed red

terminal.accuracy: Mapped stepped footprint; photo-guided facade treatment; height, window counts and interior not surveyed

rocks.accuracy: Mapped exposed bedrock and retaining-wall outlines; vertical relief approximated

ferry.accuracy: Original procedural Silja-class silhouette; approximate static berth, not a detailed licensed vessel model or live ship position

apronProps.accuracy: Appearance from photos; approximate trailer and floodlight positions, not a survey of each object

suspendedTurnSigns.accuracy: Three blue round signs: left, right, right. Original 3D plates, vector arrows, backs, clamps and two support cables. Height, diameter and anchors estimated against municipal road/pavement polygons; poles outside carriageway. August 2024 appearance, not verified current regulations.

esplanadiFronts.accuracy: Measured façade planes and widths. RATU 221 has separate pale ornate west and yellow east fronts, not a single style. Split position, window bays, mouldings and side elevations interpreted. Source roofs/courtyard walls retained.

stationLanternCarriers.accuracy: Four original geometry sculptures at the Kaivokatu main entrance, registered to footprint entrance piers. Faces, height, pedestal and hand anatomy are photo-guided approximations, not scans.

bindAds.accuracy: Invented advertising layer; not actual purchased advertising or a verified inventory of existing screens. Stop positions derived from HSL stops with pavement/road clearance tests.

limitations: Street-level photography was consulted for appearance only; no photo pixels or extracted textures are distributed.
The route remains a prototype: flattened street terrain, simple materials and generic vehicle/pedestrian models remain.
HSL trams follow dated route shapes, not surveyed rail centre lines. Stops are not fully operational boarding simulations.
Rear terminal elevations and ferry small details are interpreted; no claim of survey-exact reconstruction.
The park's small staircase, bicycle markings, traffic signal/sign inventory and harbour apron elevation need further reference work.
